translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Siem ne Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi

content.text: Ariel, Ariel,
inine malit, in dala maduongʼ mane Daudi odakie!
Meduru dhi nyime
ka utimo sewni higa ka higa.
To kata kamano abiro monjo Ariel
mi enobedi gi ywagruok kod kuyo,
kendo enochalna mana ka kendo mar misango.
Abiro lwori koni gi koni,
mi anagoni agengʼa kendo namonji gi tekona.
Nadwoki piny miwuo mana koa ei lowo;
kendo wecheni nowuog mana koa ei buru.
Dwondi nochal mana ka dwond jachien moa ei lowo;
kendo koa ei lowo dwondi nowinji.
To jowasiki mangʼeny nochal gi buru mayom,
kendo oganda mager nochal gi mihudhwe ma yamo tero.
Apoya nono, ka diemo wangʼ,
Jehova Nyasaye Maratego nobi gi mor polo
gi yiengni mar piny kod koko maduongʼ,
gi ahiti kod kalausi kendo gi mach mager.
Eka ogendini mag pinje duto makedo gi Ariel,
mamonjo kuondege motegno kendo lwore,
biro chalo mana ka lek kata ka fweny mar otieno,
mana ka ngʼama kech kayo to leko ni chiemo,
to ka ochiewo to oyudo mana ka kech pod kaye,
kendo mana kaka ngʼat ma riyo oloyo leko ni modho pi,
to ka ochiewo to opodho mana piny ka riyo oloye.
E kaka nobedi kuom ogendini mag pinje duto makedo gi Got Sayun.
Bed mobuok kendo kiwuoro,
dinuru wengeu kendo kik unen,
meruru amera to ok gi divai,
kendo themburu athemba to ok gi kongʼo.
Jehova Nyasaye osekelo nindo matut kuomu,
oseumo wengeu (un jonabi);
kendo oseumo wiyeu (un jokor wach).

content: Un to fwenyruokni duto nochalnu mana ka gima nono, mana ka kitabu modin gi duogo. To ka imiyo ngʼato manyalo somo, miwachone niya, “Yie isom kitabuni,” to obiro dwoko niya, “Ok anyal some nikech odine gi duogo.”
Kata ka imiyo ngʼat makia somo miwachone niya, “Yie isomna kitabuni,” to obiro dwoko niya, “Ok angʼeyo somo.”

content.text: Jogi sudo ira mana gi weche manie dhogi
kendo gipaka mana gi dhogi kende,
to chunygi bor koda.
Yo ma gilamago
gin mana chike mipuonjo gi dhano.
Kuom mano anachak abwog chuny jogi
gi masira bangʼ masira,
mi rieko mar jorieko nolal
kendo ngʼeyo mar joma ongʼeyo norum.
Ginine malit jogo maparo timo gimoro amora
mondo gipandgo timbegi ne Jehova Nyasaye,
ma gin joma timo timbegi e mudho ka giparo niya,
“Ere ngʼama nenowa? En ngʼa mabiro ngʼeyo?”
Iloko gik moko ataro,
mana ka gima jachwech bende chal gi lowo mochweyo!
Bende gima ochwe nyalo wachone jachwechne niya,
“Ne ok ichweya?”
Koso agulu bende nyalo wachone jachwechne niya,
“Onge gima ingʼeyo?”
Kuom ndalo matin kende, donge Lebanon nolok mana ka puodho momewo
kendo puodho momewo nochal mana gi bungu?
E kindeno joma itgi odino nowinj
weche manie kitabu, mi joma osebedo kokuyo,
kendo manie mudho mandiwa wengegi nonen.
Joma obolore nochak obed gi mor kuom Jehova Nyasaye;
kendo joma ochando,
bende nobed gi mor kuom Jal Maler mar Israel.
Joma timbegi mono nolal nono,
jo-jar ji bende nolal nono,
kendo jogo duto ma timbegi mono notieki;
gin jogo machiwo neno mar miriambo
mondo omi ngʼato onere ni jaketho,
kendo mawuondo jangʼad bura
mi omi ngʼat maonge ketho tamie adierane.

content: Kuom mano ma e wach ma Jehova Nyasaye, mane oreso Ibrahim wachone od Jakobo ni,

content.text: Jakobo ok none wichkuot kendo;
bende ok ginichak ginenre mokuyo.
Ka gineno nyithindgi ma tich lweta e kindgi,
to gibiro rito nyinga obed maler,
kendo gibiro yie kuom ler mar Jal Maler mar Jakobo,
kendo gichungʼ e nyim Nyasach Israel gi luor maduongʼ.
Joma parogi bayo noyud rieko;
kendo joma kwedo wach bende nopuonji.
